name: Derrick Townsend
office: City of Santa Monica, Member of the City Council

items.text: Derrick Townsend is an occupational therapist. He works as an aging-in-place specialist for the National Association of Home Builders. His campaign website says he wants to restore public safety and break what he calls ineffective bureaucracy. In a campaign op-ed, he criticized a $37.5 million city loan to rehabilitate a 40-unit rent-controlled apartment building as wasteful. He posted a video of homeless people sleeping on the beach, calling the scene 'Sleeping Bag Beach.' Townsend opposes closing Santa Monica Airport and proposes using it for aerospace and technical education. He also supports streamlining permits and reducing fees for businesses.
